about: Phase 6 extraction eval set. Original syllabus and handbook labels were spot-checked by the founder (2026-11-08). Slide Course assignment labels are draft, not yet spot-checked by founder; slide Topic labels come from labels/<id>.md, written blind by the founder (docs/design/topic-quality.md). `heldOut` decks run only with EVAL_HELD_OUT=1. Obligation `match` lists lowercase substrings of an acceptable title or key; `optional` items count neither as misses nor, when found, as false positives. Public handbooks are fetched by URL and cut to fixed pages, never committed.
